DRIP & DUSK / CUSTOMER CARE

Privacy policy

How we collect, use and protect your personal information when you browse, sign in or order.

Last updated 29 October 2026

Who we are

("we", "us") runs this website and is responsible for the personal information described here. You can reach us using the details at the end of this page.

What we collect

  • Order details: your name, mobile number, delivery address and PIN code, the products you order, and the order total.
  • Payment details: for Razorpay payments, Razorpay processes your card, UPI or bank details and tells us only the payment reference and status. We never see or store your card number, CVV or UPI PIN. For Direct UPI, we record the UPI transaction reference (UTR) you enter so that we can match your payment.
  • Account details: if you sign in, your email address, and your name and email from Google if you choose Google sign-in. Guest checkout does not need an account.
  • Messages: anything you send us by WhatsApp, email or Instagram, and whether you asked for WhatsApp order updates.
  • Technical information: a short-lived, anonymous browser identifier used only to prevent abuse and limit excessive requests, a sign-in session cookie if you sign in, and standard request information such as IP address that our hosting providers process to deliver the site.

Your bag, favourites and recently viewed fragrances are saved in your own browser's storage and are not sent to us unless you place an order.

How we use it

  • To process, deliver and support your order, including verifying payment and sharing your private tracking link.
  • To let you sign in and see your orders.
  • To answer your questions and send updates you asked for.
  • To keep the site secure and prevent fraud or misuse.
  • To meet our legal, tax and accounting obligations.

We do not sell your personal information, and we do not send marketing messages unless you have asked for them.

Who we share it with

Only with service providers who help us run the store, and only as needed for that purpose:

  • Razorpay, to process payments.
  • Courier partners, who receive your name, phone number and address to deliver your order.
  • Hosting and infrastructure providers (Vercel and Cloudflare), which host the website and store order records.
  • Supabase and Google, if you sign in to an account.
  • WhatsApp (Meta), if you message us there.

We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect our rights and customers.

How long we keep it

We keep order records for as long as needed to fulfil the order, handle returns and meet legal, tax and accounting requirements. Account information is kept while your account is active. Anonymous browser identifiers expire within 24 hours.

Your choices and rights

You can ask us to show, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, or withdraw consent for WhatsApp updates, by contacting us. We may need to keep some order records where the law requires it. You can clear your bag and favourites at any time by clearing your browser's site data.

Security

The site is served only over HTTPS. Order tracking links are private and unguessable, payment confirmations are verified on our server, and owner access to orders requires an approved account. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we work to protect your information.

Children

This store is intended for adults. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18.

Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it last changed.
